segments.he: מַתְנִי׳: הַמַּלְוֶה אֶת חֲבֵירוֹ לֹא יָדוּר בַּחֲצֵרוֹ חִנָּם, וְלֹא יִשְׂכּוֹר מִמֶּנּוּ בְּפָחוֹת – מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא רִבִּית.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who lends another» money «may not reside in» the borrower’s «courtyard free» of charge, «nor may he rent» living quarters «from him at less» than the going rate, «because this is interest.» The benefit he receives from living on the borrower’s property constitutes the equivalent of an additional payment as interest on the loan.

moves.cueHe: המלוה את חבירו לא ידור בחצרו חנם
moves.summary: Free or discounted residence by the lender is interest

positions.claim: a lender may not reside free or rent at a discount from his borrower, as it is interest
